EmiJourneyTimeline_prop5: Join a batch and receive your Lucky ID
EmiJourneyTimeline_prop6: You are enrolled in an active batch. The system assigns a Lucky ID (00–99) to your subscription. One customer can hold multiple Lucky IDs across different batches.
EmiJourneyTimeline_prop8: Pay your scheduled monthly EMI through approved channels (cash, UPI, bank transfer). Each payment generates an official receipt you can view in your customer portal.
EmiJourneyTimeline_prop10: Every month, a draw is conducted under published rules. A commitment hash is published before the draw, and the reveal comes afterward — so results cannot be secretly changed.
EmiJourneyTimeline_prop12: If your Lucky ID wins, remaining future EMI obligations from that month onward may be waived per plan rules. Already-paid EMI is not reversed or refunded automatically.
EmiJourneyTimeline_prop14: Delivery depends on contract readiness, stock availability, and verification checks. A delivery/handover document is generated to confirm condition and completion.
EmiJourneyTimeline_prop16: Always keep your contract, payment receipts, delivery note, and any winner confirmation documents. These form your proof of the entire transaction history.

TrustPillars_prop2: Unlike a paper register entry that can be erased or disputed, each payment in Subidha CORE generates a traceable receipt. You can view your payment receipts from your customer dashboard.
TrustPillars_prop4: Your EMI schedule is derived from the approved contract value and tenure — not from an informal note or verbal commitment. The monthly amount is clear before you enroll.
TrustPillars_prop6: Lucky draw results come from a commit-then-reveal process. The commitment hash is published before the draw, and the reveal is published afterward. No result can be secretly altered after commitment.
TrustPillars_prop8: Plan rules, rent/lease terms, delivery policies, and payment safeguards are all published on this site. You can read them before committing. No surprises after enrollment.
TrustPillars_prop10: After login, customers can see their own subscriptions, payment history, Lucky ID assignments, delivery status, and support requests — all in one place.
TrustPillars_prop12: Delivery and handover are treated as separate workflow steps. Documents are generated at handover so both customer and business have proof of the delivery event.
